concerns.text: SimulationRun schema constrains theta `minimum: 1.0`, but the sweep grid is theta∈[0.5,3.0] and research.md explicitly says 'sub-1.0 runs are retained in raw run records'. Every raw run record with theta<1.0 violates the contract, so write-time validation via artifacts.py would refuse to write (or the sweep must silently drop half the grid). Lower the schema minimum to 0.5 or restrict raw records to theta≥1.0 consistently across plan/research/data-model.

concerns.text: data-model maps `threshold_fit.json` to `aggregated_threshold.schema.yaml` '(fit fields)', but plan Phase 8 specifies different content: 'per-configuration sigmoid parameters, theta_c estimate, bootstrap CI half-width' plus a `fit_status: "failed"` field on non-convergence. The aggregated_threshold schema has `additionalProperties: false` and no fit_status/sigmoid-parameter fields, so the promised artifact cannot validate against the schema it is mapped to. Either add a dedicated threshold_fit schema or extend the mapping consistently.

data-model says support_density is 'number or null (null for non-random patterns)', but the schema declares `type: number` with min/max and lists it as non-required — there is no nullable type, so a null value (diagonal/block-sparse runs) fails validation. Align schema (e.g. type: [number, 'null']) with the data model.

Plan sanctions 'fall back to NaN + recorded fit_status' for non-convergent fits, but theta_c_estimate/theta_c_confidence are `type: number` in the schema and NaN is not a valid JSON number — the write-time validator would reject the very fallback the plan mandates. Specify a sanctioned representation (e.g. null, or a separate fit-status-bearing schema).

Phase 6 cites 'methodology-7cd8bfa6' as the addressed requirement — this ID appears nowhere in spec.md or the constitution. Replace with the actual objective/FR reference (finite-size analysis, spec Objective 1/4) or drop the pseudo-ID.
